artists.biography: The Breeders are an American alternative rock band formed in 1988 by Kim Deal of the Pixies and Tanya Donelly of Throwing Muses. The band has experienced a number of line-up changes; the current line-up consists of Kim Deal (lead vocals and guitar), her twin sister Kelley Deal (guitar and backing vocals), Jose Medeles (drums and percussion), Mando Lopez (bass guitar) Todd the Fox (guitar) and Cheryl Lyndsey (guitar); Kim Deal has been the band's sole continual member. Their first album, Pod (1990), received critical acclaim but was not commercially successful. The Breeders' most successful album, 1993's Last Splash, produced the hit single "Cannonball". The band's fourth album, Mountain Battles, was released in 2008.

perplexity.description:
LSXX is not an original studio album by The Breeders but rather the title of the 2013 deluxe 20th anniversary reissue of their landmark 1993 album Last Splash. The original Last Splash, released on August 30, 1993, by 4AD, is the band’s second studio album and stands as their most commercially successful and critically acclaimed work. Musically, Last Splash blends alternative rock, indie rock, and noise pop, characterized by Kim Deal’s distinctive songwriting, melodic basslines, and a mix of raw energy and effervescent pop sensibilities. The album features the hit single “Cannonball,” which helped propel the band into the mainstream and became an anthem of the 1990s alternative scene.

In the context of The Breeders’ discography, Last Splash marked a turning point, establishing the band as more than just a side project for Pixies bassist Kim Deal. The album reached number 33 on the Billboard 200 and was certified platinum by the RIAA by June 1994, signifying over one million units shipped. Over the years, Last Splash has received enduring critical praise, appearing on lists such as Pitchfork’s Top 100 Albums of the 1990s and Rolling Stone’s 500 Greatest Albums of All Time. Its legacy is defined by its influential sound, memorable singles, and lasting impact on indie and alternative rock.
